item.title: 1 year in, National Guard became a part of D.C. life. And, deadly quake hits Colombia
item.description: Today marks one year since the National Guard was deployed to the nation's capital. Here's what has happened since. And, a 7.4 magnitude earthquake leaves more than 100 people dead in Colombia.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Former Syrian President Assad sentenced to death in absentia
item.description: A Syrian court sentenced Assad along with his brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes during Syria's 14-year conflict that left about half a million people dead.
item.content:encoded:
A Syrian court sentenced Assad along with his brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes during Syria's 14-year conflict that left about half a million people dead.

(Image credit: Remy de la Mauviniere)

item.title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir holds elections amid calls for a boycott
item.description: Kashmir, the disputed region at the center of the rivalry between Pakistan and India, is now holding elections amid demands for better representation and calls for a boycott.

item.title: Turkey's parliament approves a pardon-like bill for thousands of PKK militants
item.description: Turkey's parliament approved legislation that would introduce a conditional pardon for thousands of Kurdish militants in a bid to advance the government's peace initiative with their insurgent group.
item.content:encoded:
Turkey's parliament approved legislation that would introduce a conditional pardon for thousands of Kurdish militants in a bid to advance the government's peace initiative with their insurgent group.

(Image credit: Metin Yoksu)

item.title: Trump pivots back to sanctions for Iran as other strategies to end his war fizzle
item.description: The shift comes as U.S. stockpiles of key weapons have dwindled and as stop-start talks seem again to have stalled. But Trump insists the pressure can lead to a breakthrough.

item.title: Magnitude 7.4 quake rocks western Colombia, killing at least 111 people
item.description: Search teams and civilians picked through the remains of destroyed buildings in the country's third-largest city, Cali, passing large pieces of concrete and rubble down a long line of volunteers.

item.title: Why Russia and Ukraine can't stop each other's air attacks
item.description: Russia and Ukraine are both striking farther into each other's territory, and neither side has a good way to stop the attacks. With no quick fix, the winter ahead could be especially hard.

item.title: Flood death toll in India's Assam reaches 100 as thousands lose their homes
item.description: Days of heavy monsoon rain has caused rivers, including the Brahmaputra, to overflow, inundating communities, disrupting livelihoods and damaging infrastructure.
